Name: Gus To Ban
Author: VulgarJuice
Description:
This mod changes Gus into Ban.


This npc replacement mod has:
-A custom name (This changes his name in other character's dialogue, below his portrait, and in events)
-A custom sprite
-A custom portrait

This npc replacement mod doesn't have:
-Custom dialogue
-Custom behaviour

Note:
-This mod [b]DOESN'T ADD [/b]a new npc to the game.
-This mod needs Platonymous' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture Mod[/url]﻿.
-This mod needs Pathoschild's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
-This mod needs Pathoschild's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 2.7.0[/url].
-This mod needs Stardew Valley v1.3.28.
[b]-Images in this mod (Original Character Sprites by ConcernedApe, Modified by me. And the portrait uploaded by Roboartitec in [url=http://nanatsu-no-taizai.wikia.com/wiki/Category:Ban_Images]this website[/url]﻿, original   uploader not stated in the website) are made by someone else and not me.
  However, it is believed that the use of this work
[list]
[*]﻿on the non-profit GusToBan Mod in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com]this website[/url]﻿.
[/list]  qualifies as [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fair_use]fair use[/url] under [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_copyright_law]United States copyright law[/url] and [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copyright_law_of_the_Philippines]Philippines copyright law[/url].[/b]

Installation:
Install Pathoschild's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 2.7.0[/url].
Install Pathoschild's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.
Install Platonymous' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture Mod[/url]﻿﻿.
Put the GusToBan folder inside "Stardew Valley\Mods"
Put the GusToBan(Portrait) folder inside "Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits"
While talking to Ban press the "P" key once.
And you're done.

Please enjoy my mod!
